title: Homotopy normal form over the local ring at a good residue point
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $P$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-derived-category] with finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module], supported in degrees $0$ through $d\in\mathbb N$. Fix $y\in Y$ and $i,r\in\mathbb N$. Suppose the termwise pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)$ has zero cohomology in every nonnegative degree different from $i$, and finite locally free cohomology of rank $r$ in degree $i$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ and let $s:S\to Y$ be the canonical morphism. Then $s^*P$ is homotopy equivalent to $s^*(\mathcal O_Y^r[-i])$, where $\mathcal O_Y^r[-i]$ denotes the single cochain complex in degree $i$. A homotopy equivalence means two chain maps whose composites are chain homotopic to the respective identities.

proof.text: Pull P back to Spec of the stalk. Pullback preserves its support and finite free terms, using pullbackFreeIso. Apply [lem-pc-finite-free-stalk-minimal-complex] to obtain a homotopy equivalent complex Q with finite free terms, nonnegative support, and zero differentials after residue reduction.

Pull the homotopy equivalence back to the residue spectrum. Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and the definition of fromSpecResidueField identify its homology with the given residue complex. ShortComplex.HomologyData.ofZeros identifies each reduced term with its homology. For a term Q.X n isomorphic to a free sheaf of rank s, pullbackFreeIso and finrank_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj_free identify its residue dimension with s. The proved helper nonempty_free_iso_of_pullback_rank combines this with isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_iff_finrank_moduleSpecΓFunctor_obj to identify Q.X i with the standard rank-r free sheaf.

For n distinct from i, negative n gives a zero term by nonnegative support. For n nonnegative, the residue hypothesis and the preceding homology identification give a zero reduced term. Its rank is zero, so the same proved rank helper identifies Q.X n with the rank-zero free sheaf; freeHomEquiv proves that this is a zero object. Thus Q is strictly supported only at i. CochainComplex.exists_iso_single and the component isomorphism at i identify Q with the single rank-r complex. Finally use singleMapHomologicalComplex and pullbackFreeIso to identify that complex with the pulled-back single complex in the goal, and compose using HomotopyEquiv.ofIso and HomotopyEquiv.trans.
